products_sale_valid.name: products_sale_valid
products_sale_valid.value: "products"."sale_price" IS NULL OR ("products"."price" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."sale_price" <= "products"."price")

products_price_required.name: products_price_required
products_price_required.value: "products"."price_mode" NOT IN ('exact','from') OR "products"."price" IS NOT NULL
